audience: fleet managers who track vehicles and maintenance in Fleetio

useCases.title: Find vehicles with open work orders
useCases.text: The AI lists work orders by status such as Open, with vehicle, vendor and technician, and opens one for its line items.

useCases.title: Check service reminders that are due
useCases.text: The AI lists preventive-maintenance reminders by status (due soon or overdue), with next-due dates and meter values, and vehicle renewal reminders.

useCases.title: Sum up fuel spending
useCases.text: The AI lists fuel entries by vehicle, vendor or date with volume, price, cost and efficiency, and totals the cost.

useCases.title: Review the service history of a vehicle
useCases.text: The AI finds a vehicle, lists its service entries and meter readings, and lists the line items of an entry.

useCases.title: Look at issues, faults and failed inspections
useCases.text: The AI lists reported issues by state, telematics fault codes, and submitted inspections with the number of failed items.

useCases.title: Log an issue or meter reading, or add a comment
useCases.text: The AI creates an issue for a vehicle or equipment, records an odometer or engine-hour reading, or adds a comment to a record.
